cover_headline: 24 VC Firms Commit ₹1,050 Crore to Deeptech Startups at Bengaluru Tech Summit

end.headline: 24 VC Firms Commit ₹1,050 Crore to Deeptech Startups at Bengaluru Tech Summit
end.line: Commitments announced at the Future Makers Conclave are 2.6 times last year's ₹400 crore, aimed at aerospace, defence, AI, robotics and semiconductor startups.

facts: Twenty-four venture capital firms announced investment commitments totalling ₹1,050.42 crore in deeptech startups at the Future Makers Conclave of the Bengaluru Tech Summit
The commitments are 2.6 times the ₹400 crore announced at last year's conclave
No disbursement schedule, and no breakdown of how the ₹1,050 crore will be allocated, was provided at the event
